components.claim: The pinned unmodified SQLite MemoryStore can be wrapped behind a neutral adapter and its retrieval-history-dependent durability can be tested deterministically.
components.notes: Source bytes are verified against the pinned store.py Git blob. Keep the component provisional until a downstream behavior experiment shows that history-dependent recall changes action or interpretation rather than only memory availability.

components.claim: Adaptive ticks, fatigue, sleep pressure, restart continuity, and wake/sleep transitions can be evaluated as operational scheduling rather than cognition.
components.notes: Do not attribute LLM-generated contemplative actions to the scheduler itself.

components.claim: Episode-to-semantic consolidation and reflection are testable donor procedures but remain LLM-mediated.
components.notes: Compare against simpler summarization and no-consolidation baselines.

components.claim: Free-form LLM rewriting should not own canonical identity state.
components.notes: May be retained later as a non-authoritative narrative-self layer.

components.claim: Dream recombination is interesting but needs controlled ablation before production reuse.
components.notes: Require comparison against ordinary reflection using the same memory seeds and model budget.

donors.notes: Treat as a mechanism and evaluation donor, not as the integration base class.

components.claim: Developer substrate state and first-person character experience should remain authority-separated.

components.notes: Do not assume success from architecture description alone. Reproduce longitudinal tests.

components.claim: Persistent plans and outcome-driven route changes are potentially reusable without making DUCK the whole runtime.
components.notes: Compare against a simpler explicit-goal baseline.

components.claim: Matched present conditions after divergent histories are a high-value causal continuity test.
components.notes: Adopt the evaluation pattern independently of production code.
